messages:
alex: Heads-up: seeing steady KV working-set growth for a subset of long-context tenants. pprof heap snapshots show a slow-but-steady increase in pinned slabs even after traffic drops. https://internal.pprof/snap/8712 :eyes:

mira: Which tenants are the worst offenders? noisy multi-conversation ones or a specific app?

sam: tenant-qa-chat1 and prod-user-42 were the top two in my check. pattern = long prompt -> big KV writes -> memory keeps climbing over hours. looks like reuse + fragmentation + leases not expiring.

irene: Can you paste the allocation stack or the lease refcount code path? wondering if we leak refs when a request errors mid-evict.

alex: Quick paste of the eviction guard we found suspicious:
```
// called on request complete/evict attempt
if (page.refcnt == 0 || page.last_access + lease_ttl < now) {
  try_evict(page);
} else {
  // keep as pinned until lease expires
}
```
We see pages with refcnt==0 but last_access keeps being bumped by background reuse accounting.

ops-bot: deploy-notification: canary/kv-lease-pulse v2 deployed to us-west-2 at 2025-09-12T14:03:12Z :rocket:

mira: Proposal: "lease-pulse" — give each tenant a soft lease budget and run a lightweight background pulse that decays residency for tenants below an active-traffic threshold. avoids hard immediate evicting and reduces fragmentation over time.

sam: Experiment plan I ran:
- per-tenant lease_budget = min(10k, active_kv_entries * 0.4)
- background sampler: every 60s, trim 2% of stale pages for tenants with active_qps < 0.2 * baseline
- exempt pages with explicit pin API or recent hot-count > 5
Result: mem-growth slope down ~30% over 6h, overall throughput unchanged. p95 latency for some tenants +3ms.

irene: Thanks. Do you have the pprof diffs and logs? any increase in page-faults or IO from extra evicts?

sam: pprof diff: heap objects down, but page-evict ops up ~18%. IO remains nominal (evict stays in-mem, spill unchanged). logs:
```
kv_evict: tenant=prod-user-42 removed=128 dwell=3723ms reason=lease_pulse
kv_access: tenant=prod-user-42 page=0x7fa ... reuse_count=2
```

alex: Fairness angle: we also need to ensure this doesn't let tenants gaming small frequently-touching keys get larger share. thinking per-tenant watermarks with a tiny per-page quota to catch micro-noisy tenants.

mira: Agree. Also add a decay multiplier based on reuse-heat: high reuse -> slower decay. low reuse -> faster. That should reduce p95 hits.

irene: Implementation note: make the pulse controller O(tenant_pages_sampled) not O(total_pages). do a weighted reservoir sample per-tenant.

alex: Next steps:
- sam to run a 48h canary on prod ring with lease-pulse + reuse-heat adaptivity.
- add metrics: tenant.evicted_by_pulse, tenant.pulse_rate, tenant.heat_percentile.
- add a knob to exempt explicit pins.

mira: If canary looks good, roll to dedicated pool and add automated alerts when pulse evictions > 10% of normal evicts for >1h. :thumbsup:

sam: Starting the 48h canary now (canary ID: kv-pulse-48h-20250912). will post graphs in #eng-runtime-canary.

alex: Awesome — thanks. keeping an eye on tail latency and fragmentation metrics. will follow up with dashboard links. :eyes:
